about.missionDesc: Equip the believer to know who you are in Christ, what you have in Christ, and what Christ can do through you.
about.revelationHeading: THE REVELATION OF JESUS ALL OVER THE WORLD!
about.revelationP1: Our vision and mission is to Reintroduce Jesus to this generation. Equipping the believer to know who you are in Christ, what you have in Christ, and what Christ can do through you. This is the vision that drives the leadership of Power City International with extension campuses all over the world.
about.revelationP2: We are wholly committed to equipping the saints to do the work of the ministry in demonstration of power. Through platforms such as the Abel Damina Mentoring Academy, Power Bible School, the Global Online Discipleship Academy, and Kingdom Life Network, we bring revelation knowledge to the nations.
about.revelationP3: Join our campuses, be trained to have a campus in your area, or learn how to access ministry resources.
about.bio1: Dr. Abel Damina is the Founder and President of Abel Damina Ministries International (ADMI) and the CEO of Kingdom Life Network (KLN) – a Christian satellite TV channel. He serves as Senior Pastor of Power City International, headquartered in Uyo, Nigeria, with extension campuses across the globe.
about.bio2: As President of Abel Damina Ministerial Equipping Network (ADMEN), he leads a global body of like-minded ministers committed to scriptural fidelity in purpose, manner of life, faith, longsuffering, and patience.
about.bio3: Dr. Damina hosts the transformative TV program "Righteous Invasion of Truth (RIOT)" on KLN and various television and radio stations, reaching millions daily. He is a prolific author and holds PhDs in Philosophy and Ministry.
about.familyDesc: Dr. Abel is happily married to his sweetheart Dr. Rachel Damina. They are blessed with three lovely children – Jemima, Jesimiel, and Jeiel, popularly known as the "Triple J plus" and producers of the popular YouTube series "BEST FRIENDS IN THE WORLD!"
